title: Inter's papers went 4 for 14 this week — the scorecard
caption:
Inter's papers made 14 claims this week and the club confirmed 4. Corriere dello Sport said the three English signings had given Chivu almost nothing — then Djed Spence took UEFA's player of the match at De Kuip and an England call-up. Gazzetta dello Sport had him at right back and got that one right. Nobody knows who starts at left back today: Sportmediaset says Carlos Augusto, Sky Sport Italia says Dimarco, Gazzetta puts Augusto in the back three. Como at San Siro, noon ET.
